question: Does public or permitted release metadata substantiate every prerequisite for designing a held-out paired laboratory glucose-insulin-C-peptide assessment in one specified T1D population?
scope: Metadata and source-document audit only; no participant records, parameter fitting, scoring, contact, request, or clinical conclusion.
interpretation: Only all requirements supported at or above their minimum evidence rank qualifies a metadata packet for scientific design review. This does not authorize data access or human-model execution.
